offering_description.value: Manufactures roofing shingles, fiberglass insulation and glass fiber reinforcements. Sells mainly to roofing contractors, builders, distributors and home improvement retailers, and to composites manufacturers, through its own plants and distribution network.

primary_products.value: asphalt roofing shingles; roofing accessories; fiberglass insulation; glass fiber reinforcements; fiberglass doors

customer_segment.value: B2B: roofing contractors, homebuilders, insulation installers, commercial builders, composites manufacturers; B2C: homeowners buying roofing and insulation through retail or contractors

end_markets.value: residential construction; commercial construction; wind energy; transportation; infrastructure

revenue_model.value: product sales: roofing, insulation, doors and glass fiber reinforcements sold to contractors, distributors, retailers and manufacturers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes shingles, insulation and glass fiber from raw materials, sold to contractors, distributors and manufacturers; brand owner: sells branded roofing and insulation products made in its own plants

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: roofing shingles and accessories, insulation, and glass fiber composite reinforcements built on shared glass and asphalt technology

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: national accounts with large builders and commercial customers; distributors / dealers: building material distributors and roofing supply dealers serving contractors; third-party retail: home improvement retailers selling roofing and insulation to homeowners
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; third-party retail

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: building codes and product standards, environmental and workplace safety rules for manufacturing fiberglass and asphalt, and energy efficiency standards for insulation
